headline: Anthropic was given the best credit rating available below investment grade in June, the Financial Times reports.
score_reason: Headline only (FT paywall); the rating dates from June; lowered 1 as unverified.
importance_line: A credit rating shapes what AI developers pay to borrow, which matters to lenders and investors, but who gave the rating and on what terms are unread, and the rating is from June, not this week.
summary: The Financial Times reports that Anthropic secured the highest junk credit rating, the top grade below investment grade, in June.
notes: FT page returned 403. The headline was also seen in a Reuters news summary on TradingView (Reuters said it had not verified it), with no article text. The event is the June rating; the report is new on 16 Oct 2026. Headline only.
